clips.title: The story
paras: At the Thandol Span, Sully Balloo's Letter carries a dwarf's final words from the icy waters below. Recovered from a drowned skeleton, it was written by a soldier lost in the battles for the bridge and addressed to his wife Sara in Ironforge.

Beneath the stone pilings of the Thandol Span, the land bridge between the Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands, a drowned dwarf's skeleton rests in the riverbed. An envelope remains clutched in his bones, its paper damaged by water. Amid the fires of battle, the soldier wrote with painstaking care. His words begin, “My dear Sara,” and carry his voice beyond the river that claimed him.

Alliance forces and their enemies have fought fiercely over the Thandol Span, from Dark Iron saboteurs to warbands contesting the borderlands. Sully Balloo was among the dwarven soldiers sent north to defend the crossing. He perished beneath the waves, and his family in the mountains did not know his fate until a diver retrieved his farewell letter.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The waterlogged and war-torn envelope dissolves in your hands, leaving you with a few pages of a letter in your grasp, written with painstaking care.
The letter is addressed to a Mrs. Sara Balloo of Ironforge and begins, "My dear Sara...."

clips.title: Progress
paras: You look as though you have traveled a great distance and seen much turmoil in your time, adventurer. These times we live in are trying on the soul. What news do you bring to me now?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You say you saw my Sully pinned beneath the icy waters? Say it isn't so!
Let me read what he wrote....
